verdict.rationale: Morph's Mintlify API reference renders a live "Try it" runner for each endpoint, generated from a published OpenAPI 3.1.0 document. Runs execute against production api.morphllm.com with the user's bearer key, which delivers an interactive reference with runnable examples. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try-it runners work, confirmation that every one of the 14 spec paths has a runner, and a sandbox or test mode (runs hit production with a real key).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify API reference renders a live "Try it" runner per endpoint (System One, Apply/chat completions, Compact, models, dedicated endpoints, credits), generated from the OpenAPI document
Morph publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Morph API") covering the public surface at api.morphllm.com
